title: Fix admin access control, show accounts only after first order, and add admin account actions

requirements.text: Change the admin “User Accounts” list so that an account only appears after the user has placed their first order (i.e., hide user profiles that have zero orders).

quotes: make there account only show up after they place there firsdt order

acceptanceCriteria: If a principal has a saved UserProfile but has never created an order, that principal does not appear in the Admin Accounts section.
After a user successfully creates their first order, their account appears in the Admin Accounts section without requiring any manual refresh beyond normal React Query invalidation/refetch behavior.
No other admin dashboard data (orders, audit log, security stats) is removed or degraded.

requirements.text: Fix the “Give admin access / Grant Admin Access” control so the owner (traviscastonguay@gmail.com) can type into the email input and successfully grant admin access.

quotes: fixx the give admin access it does not work for me
i cant type and im logged into traviscastonguay@gmail.com

acceptanceCriteria: The email input in the Admin Access section accepts typing normally (no disabled/blocked input behavior) when the logged-in user has permission to manage admin access.

Submitting a valid email calls the backend and either (a) grants access successfully or (b) shows a clear error explaining why it cannot be granted (e.g., not owner / email not associated with any principal yet), without silently failing.
The admin email list refreshes after granting/revoking access.

requirements.text: Add admin account actions to support banning/unbanning a user account, and enforce bans by blocking banned users from creating new orders.

quotes: then i can make edits to there order or account like ban give vip to threre account etc

acceptanceCriteria: Admin UI provides a clear action to Ban/Unban a selected account in the Admin Accounts section.
Backend exposes admin-only methods to ban and unban a principal, and persists the ban state in the user profile/account record.
A banned user attempting to create an order receives a clear error and no order is created.
VIP toggling continues to work as it does today.

requirements.text: Ensure admins can make edits to orders and accounts from the admin panel, including: order status updates, tracking number updates, order deletion (existing), plus account actions (VIP toggle existing + ban/unban newly added).

quotes: then i can make edits to there order or account

acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel continues to support existing order edits (status, tracking number, delete) without regression.
Admin Accounts section supports both VIP toggle (existing) and Ban/Unban (new), with clear loading/disabled states while a mutation is pending.
Errors from backend mutations are shown in English and do not break the admin page rendering.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).

Do not edit any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui).
Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister (all logic in backend/main.mo).
nonGoals: Implementing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding external databases or non-IC storage systems.
